title: Browser Switcher
description: Ask which browser or profile opens each link you click.

abilities.why: List each browser's profiles so a link can open in one
abilities.breaks: the list shows each browser once, with no profiles

abilities.why: Be asked where each clicked link opens

settings.title: Default Browser
settings.detail: Choose Olm so the links you click come here. macOS asks before it changes.

settings.title: Order
settings.detail: How the list is ordered. Used ones come first and the rest follow as you dragged them.

settings.title: Favourites
settings.detail: What the list shows when a link asks. With none checked it shows every browser and profile. Show All in the actions pane lists the rest. Drag them into order while Order is Custom.
